name: Diamond Ring Builder ‑ Jewelry
author: Keyideas Infotech Private Limited

sections.description:
Boost Your Jewelry Sales with Keyideas’ WooCommerce Ring Builder – Free to Start!

Enhance your WordPress jewelry store with our powerful, customizable Ring Builder plugin, designed to increase sales by up to 30%. Offer customers an engaging, interactive way to design their perfect ring.

Review the demo store – Natural Diamonds, Lab-Grown Diamonds, Colored Diamonds, and Gemstones.

– Supports Multiple Languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish
– Covers Global Ring Sizes
– Seamless Customization Experience: Stay ahead of online jewelry trends

Extensive Inventory Access
Gain instant access to over 200,000 diamonds and gemstones, including lab-grown, natural, and colored options.
– Compatible with Nivoda (account required)

Mobile-Optimized Experience
Deliver a fully responsive “Build Your Own Ring” feature that boosts customer engagement and conversions.
– Advanced Diamond Search – Filter by 4Cs, certification, price, and more.

Free vs. Premium Plugin

Our free plugin delivers exceptional value, but for those looking to scale, the premium version unlocks advanced sales tools:
Premium Features:

  • Full access to the Feed Center – our Diamond Management tool
  • Custom Margin Control for diamonds and gemstones
  • Strike-through Discount Pricing
  • Upload your own diamond & stone inventory
  • Robust Inventory Management
  • Pendant Builder
  • Engraving Options
  • Add RapNet, VDB or any other supplier via CSV

Pricing:

  • $125/month or $1,250/year
  • One-time setup fee: $550–$1,000 (based on your website)

Explore all updates here: WooCommerce Ring Builder by Keyideas

sections.installation:
Minimum Requirements:
– PHP 7.0 or higher
– MySQL 5.6 or higher
– WordPress 5.5 or higher

Recommended Requirements:
– PHP 8.1 or higher
– MySQL 5.7 or higher
– WordPress 6.7 or higher

  1. Upload the plugin folder to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory or install it via the WordPress Plugin Store.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Configure the plugin settings under the “Diamond Ring Builder – Jewelry” menu in your dashboard.
